The '''Neoli system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the group known as [[Neolian]]s.<ref name="EotE2" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Neoli system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square O-20.<ref name="EAOC" />
